summary: Commands that launch or may launch a browser must retain may-write MCP semantics even when the destination page initially renders read-only data.
reason: Checkout, delivery, subscription, and card-management handoffs create a local browser side effect and can lead directly to consequential authenticated actions; advertising them as read-only would let agents invoke them under the wrong safety boundary.
validated_outcome: Tool metadata no longer marks browser-opening leaves or their custom parents as mcp:read-only; checkout preview and storefront listing remain read-only.
